new_target: 5-HT1A -> PKA/CREB activity -> hippocampal neuronal adaptation and anxiety-associated program
decision_basis: Primary mouse study shows that 5-HT1A-selective agonism changes hippocampal CREB phosphorylation and that CREB blockade alters the associated behavioral response. This supports a bounded 5-HT1A-to-CREB functional association, but not a direct CREB target-locus claim or a universal SCI program.

new_target: 5-HT4 -> PKA/CREB activity -> enteric neuronal survival and neurogenesis program
decision_basis: Primary mouse enteric-neuron study shows that 5-HT4 agonists activate CREB, increase neuronal survival/development, and induce adult enteric neurogenesis; receptor antagonism or knockout blocks the responses. This supports a bounded 5-HT4-to-CREB functional association, but not a direct CREB target-locus claim or SCI transfer.

new_target: 5-HT7 -> G12/PKA signaling -> CREB activity and neuronal morphology/transcription program
decision_basis: Primary receptor-expression and neuronal studies show 5-HT7-dependent CREB reporter activation with PKA sensitivity, G12-linked transcriptional signaling, and neurite effects in neuronal models. This supports a bounded 5-HT7-to-CREB functional association, but not direct CREB occupancy at a target locus or a universal receptor-isoform mechanism.
